Ms. Shaila Afreen Mr. Karan Bapuli.
Mr. Biswajit Tiwari Mr. Anish Tiwari.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that he has instructions not to proceed with the bail application.
Learned advocate for the de facto complainant as well as the State is present.
In view of the submission advanced by the petitioner, the application for bail being CRM(M) 2748 of 2025 is dismissed as not pressed.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
